scope: Sprint1 trend page duty copy pack

reason.zh: 趋势页文案和状态口径已经齐全，但当前实际页面还没有正确消费到运行态趋势数据，因此不适合直接演示。
reason.en: The trend page wording and state model are complete, but the actual page is not yet consuming the live trend runtime correctly, so it is not ready for direct demo.
reason.vi: Copy va mo hinh trang thai cua trang xu huong da day du, nhung trang thuc te van chua doc dung du lieu runtime, nen chua phu hop de demo truc tiep.

pageIntro.zh: 趋势分析页用来回答三件事：当前变化是不是连续、关键指标有没有同步响应、动作之后曲线有没有变好。
pageIntro.en: The trend page answers three things: whether the change is continuous, whether key metrics respond together, and whether the curve improves after action.
pageIntro.vi: Trang xu huong tra loi ba viec: bien dong co lien tuc hay khong, cac chi so chinh co phan ung cung nhau hay khong, va duong xu huong co tot len sau hanh dong hay khong.

dutySequence.zh: 先看时间范围，再看曲线是否有效，最后看统计摘要确认最新/最小/最大。
dutySequence.en: Check the range first, then confirm the curves are valid, and finally read the stats for latest/min/max.
dutySequence.vi: Xem pham vi thoi gian truoc, sau do xac nhan duong xu huong co hop le hay khong, cuoi cung doc thong ke latest/min/max.

zh.sub: 当前曲线、统计与时效均可用，适合直接判断关键指标是否同步变化以及动作后趋势是否改善。

en.sub: Curves, stats, and freshness are all usable, so the page is ready to judge whether key metrics move together and whether the trend improves after action.

vi.sub: Duong xu huong, thong ke va do moi deu kha dung, nen co the dung trang nay de danh gia xem cac chi so chinh co bien dong dong thoi va xu huong co cai thien sau hanh dong hay khong.

firstAction.zh: 先看当前时间范围内是否有连续曲线，再看最新值和最小/最大是否支持你的判断。
firstAction.en: Check whether the current range contains continuous curves first, then see whether latest and min/max values support your judgment.
firstAction.vi: Truoc tien xem trong pham vi hien tai co duong xu huong lien tuc hay khong, sau do xem latest va min/max co ho tro cho phan doan cua ban hay khong.

zh.sub: 当前趋势时间戳已陈旧，曲线更适合作为历史参考，不应直接据此判断现场刚刚发生的变化。

en.sub: The current trend timestamp is stale, so the curves are better treated as historical reference and should not be used alone to judge very recent site changes.

vi.sub: Moc thoi gian xu huong hien tai da cu, vi vay cac duong xu huong nen duoc xem la tham chieu lich su va khong nen duoc dung mot minh de danh gia bien dong rat gan cua hien truong.

firstAction.zh: 先刷新趋势数据，再确认 freshness 恢复后再判断动作是否有效。
firstAction.en: Refresh the trend data first, then judge whether the action worked only after freshness recovers.
firstAction.vi: Lam moi du lieu xu huong truoc, sau do chi danh gia hanh dong co hieu qua hay khong khi freshness da hoi phuc.

zh.sub: 当前趋势链路处于 partial 或 failed，曲线和统计可能只有部分可信，可用于方向判断，不应用作完整证据。

en.sub: The trend pipeline is partial or failed, so curves and stats may be only partially trustworthy. Use them for direction, not as complete evidence.

vi.sub: Chuoi xu huong hien dang partial hoac failed, vi vay duong xu huong va thong ke co the chi dang tin mot phan. Hay dung de nhin huong, khong nen xem la bang chung day du.

firstAction.zh: 先看 sourceStatus 是哪条来源降级，再决定是继续参考现有曲线还是先补链路。
firstAction.en: Check which source is degraded in sourceStatus first, then decide whether to keep using the current curves or repair the pipeline first.
firstAction.vi: Truoc tien xem trong sourceStatus la nguon nao dang giam cap, sau do moi quyet dinh se tiep tuc tham khao duong hien tai hay sua chuoi truoc.

vi.main: Cua so hien tai dang trong
vi.sub: Kiem tra pham vi da chon

zh.sub: 当前选定时间范围下没有可展示的趋势结果，这更像时间窗口没有命中数据，不等于趋势服务异常。

en.sub: There is no trend result to show in the selected time range. This usually means the window has no matched data, not that the trend service is broken.

vi.sub: Khong co ket qua xu huong nao de hien thi trong pham vi thoi gian da chon. Dieu nay thuong co nghia la cua so khong co du lieu phu hop, khong phai dich vu xu huong bi loi.

firstAction.zh: 先切回近24小时确认服务有数据，再决定是否继续看更长时间范围。
firstAction.en: Switch back to 24h first to confirm the service has data, then decide whether to stay on a longer range.
firstAction.vi: Truoc tien chuyen ve 24h de xac nhan dich vu co du lieu, sau do moi quyet dinh co tiep tuc dung pham vi dai hon hay khong.

conditions: all(series[].points.length == 0 OR longest_continuous_numeric_run(series[]) < 3) OR all(stats[].latest is null AND stats[].min is null AND stats[].max is null)

zh.sub: 当前并非完全无数据，而是还没有形成足够连续、可解释的有效曲线，不应过早下趋势结论。

en.sub: This is not a total data outage. The current data has not yet formed curves continuous enough to support a reliable trend conclusion.

vi.sub: Day khong phai la mat du lieu hoan toan. Du lieu hien tai van chua hinh thanh duong xu huong du lien tuc de ho tro mot ket luan dang tin cay.

firstAction.zh: 先等待连续有效点补齐，再看统计摘要是否开始稳定。
firstAction.en: Wait for more continuous valid points first, then check whether the stats begin to stabilize.
firstAction.vi: Truoc tien cho them diem hop le lien tuc duoc bo sung, sau do xem thong ke co bat dau on dinh hay khong.
